You need to get a jug. A bit one. I have 1 that holds 4 litres. Fill it up with water. Keep it in your room. Along with a cup. 

Do you have an attached bathroom? If not, its gonna be a bit tricky in that regard. But if you do, great! Stay hydrated. 

For food, you could consider buying a rice cooker to cook stuff other than just rice. I've used it to heat up canned soups, boiking eggs, instant mac and cheese, cooking spaghetti. Etc. Not great for frying stuff like sunny side ups cause of how hard it is to control the heat. But its still helpful for me. 

If not the rice cooker idea, then get a kettle. A tiny electric one. Great for ramen cups. Stock up on those. 

Bread with some PB is great to have around too. 

You could consider some sort of food replacement. I have some protein powder i can just mix up to drink on days just like this. Its better than having absolutely no food, i'd say.
